name: UnSub (Fireworks AI → Cursor marketplace trojanized Claude Code extension) — Cursor
description: Cursor disclosed that an attacker obtained an access key Cursor had issued to Fireworks (exposed by Fireworks) and used it to copy data from a read-only storage bucket shared with them, holding coding-agent session traces, harvested credentials that had not been redacted from them to reach select Cursor SaaS tools and archived non-production source repositories, and on 29 Oct 2026 planted trojanized copies of Anthropic's Claude Code extension (v2.1.312 and 2.1.313) in the cache serving Cursor's VS Code marketplace for ~11 hours; at most ~5,000 users could have received them; last attacker activity 1 Nov (blocked). Cursor states Anthropic did not publish the copies and Open VSX never carried them. *Analyst note: victim-disclosed incident report; actor unattributed. Skeptic gate (cursor.com untrusted-tier): PASS on primary read.* Cursor
